title: Network-Exposed Configuration Attacks on LLM-Controlled Social Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.22761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in embodied robots create security dependencies beyond inference. We investigate a network-exposed configuration attack on the Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to replace personality settings and the cloud LLM's system prompt through a management interface, without adversarial conversational input. Eleven prompt-injection attempts across five categories were reported as resisted, whereas both configuration-layer attack paths produced observable behavioural changes on physical hardware. We demonstrate local and network-adjacent access, mapping the weakness to CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for a Critical Function) and CWE-1327 (Binding to an Unrestricted IP Address), with a reported CVSS v3.1 score of 6.5 (Medium). translated_title: 面向大语言模型控制的社交机器人的网络暴露配置攻击
translated_abstract: 具身机器人中的大语言模型（LLM）产生了超越推理层面的安全依赖。我们研究了针对Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite的一种网络暴露配置攻击，允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过管理界面替换人格设置和云端LLM的系统提示词，而无需任何对抗性对话输入。跨五个类别的十一次提示注入攻击尝试均被报告为已被成功抵御，然而两条配置层攻击路径都在物理硬件上产生了可观察的行为变化。我们演示了本地和网络邻近访问方式，将该弱点映射到CWE-306（关键功能缺少身份验证）和CWE-1327（绑定到不受限制的IP地址），报告的CVSS v3.1评分为6.5（中等）。此外，一个配置端点还会在没有CORS预检的情况下接受跨源请求（CWE-352；6.5 中等），而持久化记忆存储器存储的内容w
tldr: 本文揭示了一种针对LLM控制社交机器人的新型攻击面：攻击者无需通过对话注入提示，仅利用未经身份验证的网络配置接口即可篡改机器人的人格设置和系统提示词，绕过了传统提示注入防御。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a novel attack surface for LLM-controlled social robots: without any adversarial conversational input, an unauthenticated attacker can alter a robot's personality and system prompt through network-exposed configuration interfaces, bypassing conventional prompt-injection defenses.
